captions.text: UsageFlow: a browser simulation with synthetic data. No signup or live billing.
Start with 1,250 API calls. The guidance explains the next action.
An identical retry keeps one visitor event. Acceptance is separate from rating.
Occurrence-time pricing produces INR 3.13 for this event.
Review the month: baseline contributions plus the new event.
Owner approval is explicit. This is a comparison calculation, not a payment.
Inspect the frozen amount and stable event identity in the synthetic payload.
Demo complete. Delivery is simulated; no receiver request occurs.
Copy the public email address or inspect the source. Nothing is sent automatically.
Reset requires confirmation and restores the prepared local scenario.
Ready to explore again. Other tabs and real data are unaffected.
